en-US.description: Android log file analyzer with AI-assisted analysis
en-US.longDescription: LogTapper opens Android logcat, bugreport, dumpstate and kernel logs, runs YAML-defined processors over them to extract events, state and correlations, and exposes the results to AI agents over MCP. Installed builds update themselves.
